method: Public web open inspection of selected visible body passages from eight new Sichos in English event pages (including a separately published first sicha in the 10 Kislev farbrengen), one new Hebrew Torat Menachem PDF page, and selected pages/passages from four existing identities. No blocked crawler was retried.
verification_scope: On 12.11.2026 the visible body passages were inspected at the locators recorded on each item. English sources are publisher translations; no original-language transcripts or complete recordings were independently inspected. Hebrew sources are publisher-linked PDF pages; only the stated pages were inspected. No manuscript-level authenticity claim is made. All context status remains partial.
